landing.title: Enterprise AI Assessment
landing.subtitle: Evaluate the potential of Artificial Intelligence in your business
landing.description: Answer a few questions to receive a personalized assessment on how AI can transform your business.

industry.question: What industry does your company operate in?
industry.hint: Select the one that best describes your sector

company_size.question: How many employees does your company have?
company_size.hint: This helps us size the solution

ai_maturity.question: What is your company's AI maturity level?
ai_maturity.hint: Be honest, there's no wrong answer

main_challenge.question: What is your main business challenge?
main_challenge.hint: Identify the most urgent pain point

budget.question: What is your estimated AI budget?
budget.hint: Approximate range to size the proposal

timeline.question: What is your ideal implementation timeline?

additional.question: Anything else we should know?
additional.placeholder: Briefly describe your current situation, technologies you use, or any additional context that helps us better understand your case...

uploads.title: Additional Documents
uploads.subtitle: Upload documents that help us better understand your case
uploads.drag_drop: Drag files here or click to select
uploads.formats: PDF, DOC, DOCX, XLS, XLSX, PNG, JPG (max. 10MB)

confirmation.title: Assessment Completed!
confirmation.subtitle: Thank you for completing the assessment. Our team will analyze your case and contact you within the next 24 hours.
